design: Use the same field-filter reference and fixed pulse slice on the next separately started acquisition. Compare early local versus reference error using two nonoverlapping fit-validation pairs of 10 percent blocks. Require both comparisons to favor local and all four blocks to clear the inherited count floor. The single-trial benchmark pools adjacent early blocks into two 20 percent groups. Both choices use the same pooled local candidate when it is supported. Freeze early choices before pairing held blocks.
boundary: The tested operation transfers from the Uppsala timing procedure to the air-filter apparatus. The reference and detector settings are specific to the air-filter readout. The early validation pairs are disjoint time blocks within one acquisition and can share temporal drift.
